title: Sandia National Labs SA3000 8085 CPU
summary: A historical article about the Sandia National Labs SA3000, a radiation-hardened variant of the Intel 8085 microprocessor designed for aerospace and defense applications in harsh environments.
problem_solved: Provides documentation of specialized military-grade computing hardware that operated reliably in radiation-intensive environments like space and nuclear facilities.
why_valuable: Preserves computing history by documenting rare radiation-hardened CPU variants developed for critical defense and space applications that are rarely covered in mainstream tech literature.
